achievements.title: Monsoon Commander
achievements.description: Cast Rain successfully at least 100 times before winning a battle.

achievements.title: Invasion Repelled
achievements.description: Win a Normal, Hard or Back battle after taking out at least 100 enemies.

achievements.title: Three Forces of Nature
achievements.description: Win a battle after casting Earthquake, Tsunami and Meteor.

achievements.title: Victory Past Zero
achievements.description: Win a Normal, Hard or Back battle after time expires and triggers extinction.

achievements.title: Rise of a King
achievements.description: Evolve one of your own Tyranno into King Tyranno during a numbered stage.

achievements.title: The PUGU Challenge
achievements.description: Enter PUGU in the password menu and win the resulting battle.

achievements.title: The PPPP Challenge
achievements.description: Enter PPPP in the password menu and claim victory on that map.

achievements.title: Clear Water Ahead
achievements.description: Cast Tsunami with the battlefield clear of units to see the surfing Tyranno.
